class.name: BufferRD
class.brief_description: Immutable borrowed storage buffer for read-only native spatial shader uniforms.
class.description: Wraps a storage buffer created on the global [RenderingDevice] for a material-local [code]uniform readonly_buffer[/code]. This experimental path supports Vulkan and Forward+ only. The record layout is a runtime array of 16-byte [code]uvec4[/code] records; shaders use [code]buffer_load(buffer, index)[/code] and [code]buffer_length(buffer)[/code]. Loads outside the record range return zero. No buffer data is uploaded, copied, or read back when attaching or binding this resource. The caller owns the [RenderingDevice] RID. This resource never frees it and does not pin its lifetime. Remove the resource from every material, wait for queued rendering to finish, then free the buffer on the rendering thread. Destroying this resource leaves the caller's buffer alive. Missing or freed bindings use one zero record, so their length is 1. This safety fallback is not permission to free a buffer while a draw is using it. Attachment is immutable: attaching the same live RID again succeeds; replacing it requires a new [BufferRD] resource. Assign non-null buffer parameters using [method ShaderMaterial.set_shader_parameter] on the rendering thread, after attachment. Invalid replacements leave the previous parameter unchanged. Serialize mutations of the same material; do not change it concurrently from another thread. Shader parameters accept an attached [BufferRD] or [code]null[/code] to clear the binding, not a bare RID or a texture. GPU RIDs are runtime-only and are not serialized.

method.name: attach_storage_buffer
method.description: Call on the rendering thread using [method RenderingServer.call_on_render_thread]. The buffer must belong to the global RenderingDevice, have storage usage, and contain at least 16 bytes with a size divisible by 16. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] for a valid first attachment or the same live RID, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for invalid storage, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] for a different valid RID after attachment, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] off the rendering thread or on an unsupported renderer. Failure leaves the previous attachment unchanged and emits no error log.

method.name: get_buffer_rd_rid
method.description: Returns the borrowed RenderingDevice RID, or an invalid RID before attachment. In this implementation [method Resource.get_rid] returns the same RID. The identity getter does not wait for GPU work or check that the caller has kept the buffer alive.

members.member: The immutable borrowed RID. Use [method attach_storage_buffer] to set it once.
